<span class="hl-kw">from</span> __future__ <span class="hl-kw">import</span> annotations
<span class="hl-kw">from</span> typing <span class="hl-kw">import</span> <span class="hl-type">Any</span>, <span class="hl-type">Literal</span>
<span class="hl-kw">from</span> dataclasses <span class="hl-kw">import</span> dataclass


<span class="hl-comment">@dataclass(frozen=True)</span>
<span class="hl-kw">class</span> EFData:
    a: <span class="hl-type">str</span> | <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    b: <span class="hl-type">int</span> | <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    j: <span class="hl-type">str</span> | <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    k: <span class="hl-type">int</span> | <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    c: <span class="hl-type">float</span> | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    d: <span class="hl-type">bool</span> | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    e: <span class="hl-type">str</span> | <span class="hl-type">int</span> | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    f: <span class="hl-type">str</span> | <span class="hl-type">float</span> | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    g: <span class="hl-type">list</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>] | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    h: <span class="hl-type">dict</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>, <span class="hl-type">Any</span>] | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    i:  | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    l: <span class="hl-type">Literal</span>[] | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    m: <span class="hl-type">Literal</span>[] | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    n:  | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>

    @classmethod
    <span class="hl-kw">def</span> from_dict(<span class="hl-kw">cls</span>, data: <span class="hl-type">dict</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>, <span class="hl-type">Any</span>]) -&gt; EFData:
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">cls</span>(
            a=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;a&quot;</span>),
            b=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;b&quot;</span>),
            j=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;j&quot;</span>),
            k=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;k&quot;</span>),
            c=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;c&quot;</span>),
            d=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;d&quot;</span>),
            e=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;e&quot;</span>),
            f=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;f&quot;</span>),
            g=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;g&quot;</span>),
            h=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;h&quot;</span>),
            i=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;i&quot;</span>),
            l=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;l&quot;</span>),
            m=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;m&quot;</span>),
            n=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;n&quot;</span>),
        )

    <span class="hl-kw">def</span> to_dict(<span class="hl-kw">self</span>) -&gt; <span class="hl-type">dict</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>, <span class="hl-type">Any</span>]:
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> {
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;a&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.a,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;b&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.b,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;j&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.j,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;k&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.k,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;c&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.c,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;d&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.d,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;e&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.e,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;f&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.f,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;g&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.g,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;h&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.h,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;i&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.i,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;l&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.l,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;m&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.m,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;n&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.n,
        }
